checked_by: go list -deps, filtered by Go's rule that stdlib paths have no dot in the first element

fields.go[].module: string, module path as `go list -deps` reports it
fields.go[].why: string, required; a dependency with no reason fails
fields.limits.go_modules: int, maximum modules linked into tools/od
fields.limits.native: int, maximum native libraries linked into the game
fields.native[].name: string
fields.native[].pinned: string, required; an unpinned native library fails
